title: IndiaAI Startups Global Acceleration Programme
summary: IndiaAI Startups Global is an acceleration programme of MeitY's IndiaAI Mission, run with Station F and HEC Paris. The government lists it as the main activity under the mission's startup financing pillar. Launched on 6 March 2025, it takes ten Indian AI startups per cohort through an online phase and a three-month residency at Station F in Paris, with mentoring, investor meetings and support for entering European markets. IndiaAI covers programme fees, and for the first cohort also travel and accommodation. A second cohort of ten startups was selected in April 2026, each eligible for up to ₹5 lakh in prize money.
beneficiaries: Indian AI startups, early stage to Series C
